title: 小型の気象観測マスト
description: 公園・公共菜園・屋上の風景に配置する小型気象観測装置の静的な外観模型。3脚で支えたマスト、実際に中空の3杯式風杯、矢羽根、隙間のある放射シールド、開いた雨量収集漏斗、無表示の接続箱と短い配線を備えます。気象データ・校正・測定機能・可動機構・電源・外部ネットワークは含まず、気候測定の精度や機器の安全性・認証は主張しません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.896 × 2.251 × 0.640 m、13,456三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A static compact weather-instrument appearance prop for park, community-garden and rooftop scenery, with a tripod-supported mast, three genuinely hollow anemometer cups, a directional vane, a gapped radiation shield, an open rain-collector funnel, a blank junction box and short cable routing. No weather data, calibration, measurement functions, moving mechanism, power supply or external networking are supplied; no climate-measurement accuracy, equipment-safety or certification claim is made. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.896 × 2.251 × 0.640 m; 13,456 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
